name: io.github.Kiragu-Maina/shellwire
title: ShellWire
description: Discover and compare software, read chatbot news, and submit applications for private review.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public reads. Builder operations require Bearer <token> from ShellWire email OTP. See https://shellwire.com/connect. Tokens expire after eight hours. This is not OAuth.

com.shellwire.submissionReview: Private operator review. Requires a verified email and visible ShellWire backlink on the submitted site root homepage. Builder tokens cannot publish listings.
